design_philosophy: Enterprise-grade trust meets localized Sierra Leonean warmth. The dashboard utilizes a strict 'Control Room' grid for dense data management (payroll, tax, compliance), paired with an earthy, distinctly Sierra Leonean palette (Deep Forest Green, Ocean Blue, Sunset Terracotta). Typography is serious and structured to handle complex financial data (SLE) without feeling sterile.

rules.currency: Always use tabular-nums for SLE currency displays
rules.labels: Uppercase, tiny, wide-spacing (tracking-[0.05em]) for table headers and overlines

layout.sidebar: fixed left, w-64, dark theme (bg-[#133326]) for strong enterprise grounding
layout.topbar: sticky top, h-16, glassmorphism or pure white with 1px bottom border

buttons.primary: bg-[#133326] text-white rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium hover:bg-[#0F281E] transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-[#E2DFD6] text-[#133326] rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium hover:bg-[#F7F6F2] transition-colors
buttons.accent: bg-[#D1603D] text-white rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium hover:bg-[#B84F2F] transition-colors

tables.header: bg-[#F7F6F2] text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-[#525860] border-b border-[#E2DFD6] py-3 px-4
tables.row: border-b border-[#E2DFD6] hover:bg-[#FDFCFB] transition-colors text-sm text-[#1A1C1E]

inputs.style: bg-white border border-[#E2DFD6] rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#26547C] focus:border-transparent

motion.page_transition: framer-motion opacity-0 to opacity-100, slight y-axis slide (y: 10 to y: 0)
motion.stagger: lists and table rows stagger entrance by 0.05s

images.description: Sierra Leone mountain sunset landscape to use as a warm, localized login screen background with a dark overlay.
Professional African businesswoman portrait for employee directory.
Professional African business portrait for employee directory.

accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='run-payroll-button')
accessibility.contrast: Strict adherence to WCAG AA, using tabular-nums for SLE amounts

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use 'Cabinet Grotesk' for Headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for Body text.
Build a desktop-first dashboard with a dark sidebar (#133326) and off-white/sand main area (#F7F6F2).
Cards and widgets must use white backgrounds with crisp 1px borders (#E2DFD6) to contrast the sand background.
Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide React for crisp dashboard iconography.
Implement the specific modules mentioned: Payroll (SLE currency formats), HR, Compliance (NRA/NASSIT).
For the login page, use the 'login_background' image with a dark gradient overlay (bg-black/60) and a clean, glassmorphic or solid white login card.
Ensure all monetary values (SLE) use the 'tabular-nums' utility for perfect vertical alignment in tables.
Avoid generic purple/violet SaaS colors entirely; stick to the earthy Green/Sand/Blue/Terracotta palette.
